notes.title: ANNOUNCEMENT: We need your support! (Kickstarter)
notes.content:
ANNOUNCEMENT: Crowdfunding

The Kickstarter for Somber Heaven is now LIVE! 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nikoskipz/somber-heaven-open-world-action-rpg?ref=user_menu
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45369155/ce764487476645d80d13336bf6943412680e1b9d.png

I'm asking for your support! if you can, please support and back this project. This project has been an absolute dream of mine ever since I was a kid.. I'm so excited and happy to finally have the opportunity to work on this, and we won't be able to do it without this extra bit of funding.. 

I will be needed these for Somber Heaven's Development:

 PC Upgrades: Graphics Card with a lot of VRAM to develop the open world, bigger power supply to handle  the new GPU and multiple screens for multi-tasking
 Motion Capture Suit: Somber Heaven will have a bunch of animations, ranging from Movement, Combat to Cutscenes. All of this will be impossible to do without a motion capture suit.
 Music Equipment: Better music equipment means easier music production and better music! 
 Voice Actors: Sonara is a big world, and it should be a world that has a voice. I'll be putting up out of my own pocket for VA's but with crowdfunding that'll help keep the costs a lot lower.


and with Kickstarter (and your help!), all of that will become a reality!

If you've already backed the project, I just want to give you a HUGE thank you from the bottom of my heart! If you're thinking about backing the project..

You can back the project on kickstarter right here:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nikoskipz/somber-heaven-open-world-action-rpg?ref=user_menu
